note: All 55 trophies are offline single-player. There are NO online trophies. Platinum takes roughly 200-250 hours. Guides below are written in our own words; each cites its source.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks automatically the moment the last one pops. There is no online trophy and no DLC trophy, so everything is done in single-player Leonida. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks cleanup — and the platinum is the final reward, not a separate task.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 as Jason. Follow the on-screen prompts through the mission and the trophy pops when it ends. It is automatic and cannot be missed — it is the first story trophy of the game.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies pop a little late, after the first mission or two of the next chapter, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant Chapter 1 ends. While you are in Chapter 1, do the one missable step in the whole game: the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy). Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. From Chapter 2 onward Jason and Lucia can roam together, which opens partner trophies such as Hot Together and Retail Therapy. The trophy may pop a mission or two into Chapter 3 — that late pop is normal.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. This chapter opens several trophy tools: the Snap Gun from a main mission (needed for the undetected jewelry robbery, Sneakthief) and the dye-pack jammer (needed to launder marked bills for Dime on the Dollar). Take the optional missions as they appear — 100% completion only needs any 100 of several hundred, but doing them as you go saves backtracking.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Chapter 4 is the busiest for named story trophies — three of the six specific-mission trophies land here (Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked) — and an optional mission here opens the bank jobs that Maximum Withdrawal needs. Keep a manual save at the chapter start, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the game in Chapter 5. It is automatic and unmissable — just play the story to its end. Because there is no mission replay, keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 5 in case you want to replay the finale later. This is one of only two gold trophies; the other is A Long Road for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is one of six trophies tied to a specific named mission, and it is automatic — play the mission when it appears in the story and the trophy pops at its end. Nothing special is needed: no time limit, no optional objective.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. Like the other named-mission trophies it is automatic and unmissable — finish the heist and the trophy pops. Note that a bank job also counts toward A Classic Blitz Play (rob an armored truck), so the heist mindset carries over into the side content that follows.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It is automatic and unmissable — play the mission when the story brings it to you. Chapter 4 holds three of these named-mission trophies, so expect them to arrive close together as the chapter unfolds.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. Automatic and unmissable — finish the mission and the trophy pops. If you are tracking the story trophies in order, this is the second of the three Chapter 4 named-mission trophies, between Child's Play and the VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, at Vice City International Airport. Automatic and unmissable. The airport setting is worth remembering: the same airport is where Catch Me If You Can happens later — stealing a passenger jet docked at a gate and flying it about a kilometre away.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is the only named-mission trophy in the final chapter, and it is automatic and unmissable. Finish it, then finish the final mission itself for the gold trophy You Gotta Know When to Get Off.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist, found under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — it appears after the story ends, and everything you did earlier already counts toward it. The thresholds are lenient (about 60% true completion): 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts, all bank vaults, all drone races, all shooting ranges, all of Bret's quests and 15 of 18 card sets. This is the hardest trophy in the game and the whole of roadmap Step 2, roughly 100 hours — chip away at the checklist between story missions instead of leaving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. There are 397 stunts in total across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, so you have plenty of slack — and the 100% checklist needs 300, so keep going past 250. Stunts count as you play naturally, but the fastest route is to work through the marked stunt jumps and bridge flights systematically, since each one is a fixed, repeatable spot on the map.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it — so the quickest path is to sample them one by one early on. Fishing and the shooting range are available from the start of the open world, and a single stunt counts the moment you land one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 separate challenges, so treat this as a grind, not a single visit: learn each range's target pattern, use the range's own weapons, and replay any challenge that lands on silver until it turns gold. The range also counts toward Master of None, and the 100% checklist needs all shooting ranges done, so this trophy and A Long Road share the same work.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you must win all 14 — winning the same one twice does not help. Learn each course's racing line on a practice run, then race it for real; drone handling is the skill being tested, not speed alone. The 100% checklist needs all drone races too, so this is Step 2 work.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same race. Mix race types (street, off-road, drone and water races all count toward the pool) and pick the easiest events first; repeat a race you already won does not add to the count. Keep a mental list of which events you have won, or check the race menus, so you do not waste time re-winning the same one.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You meet Cal in Chapter 1, and after that he texts you a fishing spot — go to it and take the challenge. Fishing is a timing mini-game: watch the line tension and reel steadily rather than mashing, and do not let the fish run the line out. Winning the challenge against Cal is the only requirement; casual fishing elsewhere does not count.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Three arcade games run on the TV at home, and a fourth is on arcade machines out in the world — pick whichever you like and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score or a win, just a completed game, so choose the shortest or easiest of the four and finish it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's side strand. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and starts with a phone call in Chapter 3 — answer it and follow the strand's missions through to the last one. Stranger strands stay available after the story, so there is no rush, but do not ignore the call: it is the trigger that opens the whole strand.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's treasure-diving strand, which covers 7 shipwrecks. Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns later in the game — that silence is scripted, not a missed chance, so this trophy is NOT missable. When he returns, dive each wreck in turn and finish his strand's last mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's strand at the mud club in Kelly County. The strand opens in Chapter 2 — head to the mud club, meet Billy and work through his missions. Like the other stranger strands it stays open after the story, so finish it in the Step 3 cleanup if you do not do it as you go.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. There are 14 strands in the game but only some of them count toward this trophy, and which ones count is still being confirmed — so do not stop at exactly 8; work through the strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest) and the trophy will pop once you have finished 8 of the counting ones. Strangers & Freaks is NOT part of the 100% checklist, so these strands may still be waiting for you in Step 3 after the platinum checklist is done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's strand: his wish list of 16 sports cars. The strand opens in Chapter 3. The work is collecting — find and deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's list, using the WAiNK app to scan new vehicles as you meet them (scanning also feeds Whip It Good and the 100% vehicle count). Deliver the last car and finish his final mission to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand by shutting down labs in Vice City. The strand is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 3. Work through Tyrone's missions, taking out each lab he points you at, until the strand's final mission appears. It stays available after the story, so it fits the Step 3 cleanup.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MOST IMPORTANT TROPHY IN THIS GUIDE — the only one that can possibly be missed. Meditate at all 18 spots (10 locations; Jason and Lucia each count, so +2 per spot at the same location). Track your progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE STEP: during Chapter 1, one morning at Jason's house, Lucia says she will meditate and walks to the balcony — FOLLOW HER and accept the optional quest. That chance is gone after Chapter 1. It is not yet confirmed whether that spot is required for the trophy, but the guide who did it saw the trophy unlock, so do it. The final meditation needs both characters playable together, which happens after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break). Note: 100% completion only needs 15 of 18 spots, so even if you miss the balcony you can still earn A Long Road — but you could lose this trophy, so protect it in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. The strand is Jason-only and opens in Chapter 2. Which exact animal counts has NOT been confirmed yet — but clearing all 15 of Bret's target decks, which the 100% checklist needs anyway, should cover it. So do Bret's hunting work thoroughly as part of Step 2: study animals with binoculars (100% needs 100 of 255 studied, no hunting required for that part) and take down each of Bret's targets as they come up, and the trophy should pop along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets out of 18. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so collect as you travel rather than hunting them all at once — scan new areas with WAiNK and pick up cards you pass. You only need 3 full sets for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18 sets, so keep collecting well past the third set; every set you finish now is one less for Step 2.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures across Leonida. Open the WAiNK app, point it at a landmark and scan it; each new location counts once. Build the habit from the start of the game: scan every new place you visit, and the 100 will accumulate naturally. WAiNK scanning is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges. Challenges are small goals spread across everything you do — driving, shooting, flying, collecting — so they fill up as you play, but check the challenge list regularly and chase the easy ones deliberately: the ones tied to things you are already doing (stunts, races, scanning) are free progress. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so push past 50 toward 70 in Step 2.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner alongside you, and escape. This becomes possible once Jason and Lucia can roam together, from Chapter 2 onward. The easy setup is a bank job, which gives you 4 stars anyway — or cause enough chaos with your partner in the car until the fourth star appears, then break line of sight, hide until the wanted level clears, and the trophy pops when you escape. Do not let your partner get separated from you mid-chase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Pick three shops close together, rob the first, then drive straight to the next two without letting the wanted level drop — you must keep the heat the whole time. It pops about 30 seconds after the third shop, so do not panic if it does not appear instantly. Plan the route first, keep your partner with you, and avoid getting arrested between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK is enough — you do not have to drive it, steal it or own it. Scan every new vehicle you see from the start of the game, and the 100 will come quickly; the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this trophy pops. City streets, parking lots and traffic are all full of fresh models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. The trick is picking the right enemies: gang members count, while soldiers, police and civilians seem not to. Find a gang shootout or a gang hideout with at least 5 gang members grouped together, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five of them before the focus ends. If it does not pop, you likely downed the wrong enemy type — try a gang location again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a gate at Vice City International Airport and fly it about 1 kilometre away. Enter the airport, reach a jet parked at a gate, get in and take off — then just fly away from the airport until the trophy pops, roughly a kilometre out. Expect a wanted level on the ground, so move fast and take the most direct route to a jet; once you are airborne the hard part is over.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). They have been found at Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest of the map — head there, find a parked Rhino, get in and drive it away. Military bases are guarded, so expect resistance on the way in; a fast approach, or clearing the area first, makes the steal far easier. Once you are in the driver's seat and moving, the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. You need the Snap Gun for this, which a Chapter 3 main mission gives you — so this trophy cannot be done before Chapter 3. With the Snap Gun in hand, enter a jewelry store, use it to quietly deal with the security and take the goods without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; a clean, undetected run is the requirement, not speed.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4 — take it when it appears, because it unlocks the whole bank-robbery side content. There are 8 vaults in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so rob more than the 5 this trophy asks for. Each vault needs a clean getaway: plan your escape route before you go in, and expect a heavy wanted level on the way out.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The first bank job counts toward this, so it may pop on its own during Maximum Withdrawal. If you want it earlier, find an armored truck on the road and blow open its back door with a sticky bomb, grab the cash and escape before the police close in. Either way, the getaway is part of the trophy — you must escape, not just open the truck.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. The goal is to clear the fog from the whole map, visiting every named area. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map, touching down in each area you have not visited. Check the map's fog as you go: any greyed-out patch is an area you still need to enter. This pairs naturally with WAiNK scanning and vehicle discovery, so explore thoroughly rather than fast-travelling everywhere.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang is enough for this trophy. Find a gang's operation, rob it and get away. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations robbed, so keep going after the ninth gang: every operation you clear now is progress toward A Long Road. Learn which gangs control which areas so you can tick them off one gang at a time.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — the exact method is not confirmed. The trophy description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely trigger is ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx has not confirmed the exact spot or trigger, so treat this as a lead, not a certainty: try the Ocean Beach bars, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. This guide will not invent a confirmed method where none exists yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — the exact method is not confirmed. The description points to smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, which most likely means driving a car through a showroom's front window and out onto the street. PowerPyx has not confirmed the exact showroom or trigger, so try a vehicle showroom in Vice City and make a dramatic exit through the glass. No confirmed method exists yet — do not trust any guide that claims otherwise without a source.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn. Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, rob the gang operation there and collect all three key valuables. If you miss one, the robbery comes back later — this trophy is NOT missable, so just return and finish the job.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out strength on both Jason and Lucia. Work out together — training as a pair raises both characters' strength, so do not train one and ignore the other. Use gyms and workout spots regularly between missions; strength builds gradually, so fold workouts into your routine from early in the game rather than leaving it all for the end.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Do 500 things that change your criminal profile. This is a pure volume trophy: every choice that moves your criminal profile counts, and it comes naturally over a full playthrough — robberies, stunts, races, heists and side content all feed it. There is nothing to plan and nothing to miss; just play the game, check your criminal profile progress in the menus now and then, and it will pop during Step 2.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — the exact method is not confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a link to a Payday Loans store, and the description (second time's the charm) suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The honest position is that nobody has confirmed the trigger yet: try the Payday Loans stores, and if something fails there the first time, try it again. This guide will not invent a confirmed method where none exists yet.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — the exact method is not confirmed. PowerPyx suspects a UFO questline: something strange in the sky, and a chain of events that follows it. The description reads like a reaction to witnessing something unexplainable. Until the trigger is confirmed, the best lead is to watch for strange sky events and UFO-related content around Leonida, especially at night, and follow any questline that starts from them.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED — the exact method is not confirmed, but the in-game hint points to a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and PowerPyx suspects a kick from a motorcycle. The practical lead: ride a motorcycle, pull alongside a pedestrian, and land a melee kick while moving. Try it on a quiet road with a single target, and repeat until the hit registers — the trigger is the moving melee hit, not the vehicle itself.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts (fences). The total adds up across robberies, so you do not need $250,000 in one job — keep laundering after every robbery and the total climbs. The dye-pack jammer you need unlocks in a Chapter 3 main mission, so this trophy only opens up from Chapter 3 onward. Rob, launder, repeat.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every shop in the game, and the fastest way there is the big-ticket spending: guns, car modifications and tattoos. Buy the weapons and upgrades you actually want as you play, mod your favourite cars, and the $100,000 will arrive without you having to waste money on things you do not need.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages. The real-estate app arrives in Chapter 2, and the total cost is about $160,000 — so save up rather than spending everything on car mods first. Garages are also practical, not just a trophy: you need garage space before you can register vehicles for On the Spot, so buy the garages, then register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app and earn both trophies together.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. You need garage space first, so pair this with Little Boxes: buy the garages, then register ten vehicles you own through the app. Any ten vehicles count, so use the cars you already have rather than buying new ones just for this — register, confirm, and repeat ten times.
